remaining_blocker.what: runtime/secrets/github_token is a fine-grained PAT that still authenticates as LinzeColin but resolves neither the old nor the new Vault repository, on the repo endpoint and on its granted contents and releases endpoints alike. A fine-grained token selects repositories by ID, so recreating the repository under the same name cannot re-attach it.
why_not_worked_around: github_markdown_token reaches Private-Database and MetaDatabase with admin, but a selected-repository token cannot be widened to a newly created repository through any GitHub API.
Using the broad local OAuth credential on the production host is forbidden by the taskpack and by the prior recorded boundary.
Retargeting the third copy at Private-Database would pass the command while conflating the object-bytes plane with the structured-facts plane, so it was rejected.
remaining_blocker.single_next_step: Mint a fine-grained token whose only repository is LinzeColin/Social-Archive-Vault with Contents: read and write, then write it to /opt/social-archive/runtime/secrets/github_token as 0600. This is a GitHub UI action that no API can perform.
